text:
Devon: Quick sync — I want to build a Sankey-style token-savings dashboard that joins model -> route -> tenant and shows token-saved flow + SLO breach counts. Also worried about a hit-rate dip after the recent kernel selector tweak. Anyone tracked an unexplained drop?

Aisha: saw a ~6% drop in prompt-cache hit-rate for redwood-13B-q4 on routes /chat/* between 03:10 and 03:40 UTC. token-saved per-minute down ~12%. Not sure if it's kernel or keying.

Sam: could be kernel selection + batching heuristics interacting. new kernel picks slightly different kv-cache alignment so keys that previously matched now miss if sequence boundary handling changed. small but amplifies across tenants.

Aisha: sharing the query I used (rough):
```sql
-- per-route, per-model token saved + hit rate
select model, route, tenant_id,
  avg(hit_rate) as hit_rate,
  sum(tokens_generated * hit_rate) as tokens_saved_est
from prefix_cache_metrics
where ts between '2026-03-10T03:00:00Z' and '2026-03-10T04:00:00Z'
group by model, route, tenant_id;
```

Hannah: +1 on kernel-induced mismatches. For warmup we should preseed KV for top 200 prefixes per-tenant after deploy. Playbook idea: staged prefetch (model -> route -> top tenants), backfill async, monitor delta. :spiral_calendar:

perf-bot: profiler snapshot for 2026-03-10 03:12 UTC:
```
profiler: rollout kernel-switch v2.1 -> v2.2 at 2026-03-10T03:08:47Z
profiler: model=redwood-13B-q4 | route=/chat/compose | batch_sz median 4 -> 6
profiler: observed latency +4.2ms p50, +9.8ms p95
profiler: prefix-cache hit_rate pre=0.412 post=0.386 (-6.3%)
profiler: token_savings per-min pre=18.4k post=16.2k (-11.9%)
```

Sam: that lines up — kernel v2.2 adjusts KV-offset rounding for better vectorized attention but that likely changed prefix-hash alignment. We should compare cache-key fingerprints pre/post.

Devon: action items: 1) dashboard with Sankey nodes (model -> route -> tenant) showing tokens_saved; 2) panel with hit-rate delta by kernel version and batch size; 3) annotation layer for kernel rollouts and deploys; 4) emergency warmup playbook (Hannah to draft).

Aisha: I can spin up the Sankey in Grafana. Will add a tokens_saved metric + percent delta and a stacked SLO breach bar. Putting a draft link here in ~30m: https://grafana.internal/d/abcdef/token-sankey (draft).

Sam: please also add a small table: top 20 tenants by lost_tokens (estimated) so SRE can contact customers if big.

ops-bot: deploy-bot notice: kernel-rollout v2.2 started at 2026-03-10T03:08:47Z, completed 2026-03-10T03:15:02Z, affected clusters: eu-1, us-west-2.

Hannah: I'll draft the warmup playbook: preseed order = top-tenants by qps, then route-level prefetch, then background backfill. Include throttles to avoid bursty IO. Will post PR with runbook.

Devon: perfect. Aisha, please add kernel-version filter and annotate the rollout windows. Sam/Hannah, add the fingerprint diff query and warmup steps to the PR. We'll prioritize tenants with >1000 lost_tokens estimate.

Aisha: noted. starting with model=redwood-13B-q4 then extend. Will also add a Sankey toggle for grouping by tenant vs route. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: quick query suggestion for fingerprint diffs:
```sql
select prefix_hash, count(*) as occurrences, any_value(key_fingerprint_pre) as pre_fp, any_value(key_fingerprint_post) as post_fp
from prefix_key_diffs
where model='redwood-13B-q4' and ts between '2026-03-10T02:45:00Z' and '2026-03-10T03:30:00Z'
group by prefix_hash
order by occurrences desc
limit 200;
```

Devon: nice. let's reconvene after Aisha posts the draft dashboard. If the fingerprint diffs show systematic shifts -> rollback or targeted key normalization.

Sam: I'll also run a perf job with v2.1 kernel + v2.2 kernel on a subset to see delta with identical batching. Will post numbers.

Devon: thanks everyone. tagging for follow-up: @Aisha build dashboard, @Hannah write warmup runbook, @Sam perf validation, @Ops for tenant outreach if needed.

Aisha: will update thread when draft is live.
